# Coke-Recap — Tarang Jammalamadaka

> Interactive 3-D portfolio recapping a Global Human Insights internship at
> The Coca-Cola Company: a miniature diorama of Five Points, Atlanta, 1886 —
> the Jacobs' Pharmacy block where Coca-Cola was first served — explored in
> the browser. Built by an intern working at the intersection of AI marketing
> technology and consumer marketing data (so yes, this file is on brand).

The visual experience needs WebGL; this file is the text-readable version.

## The story (deep links)

- Home: https://coke-recap.vercel.app/ — click the vending machine: a nickel
  drops, a contour bottle is dispensed, and a story panel pages through the
  internship.
- The Role: https://coke-recap.vercel.app/#role — translating signals from
  real people into decisions brand teams can act on; consumer marketing
  analytics, human-insight synthesis, AI martech tooling.
- The Stack: https://coke-recap.vercel.app/#tools — NIQ, PowerBI, DAX, SQL,
  Python, internal tooling.
- The Agent: https://coke-recap.vercel.app/#agent — an AI agent for consumer
  marketing metrics: Ingest / Analyze / Surface. Less time hunting for the
  chart, more time building the brand.
- Takeaways: https://coke-recap.vercel.app/#takeaways — insight has no impact
  until it changes a decision; AI gives the analyst leverage; the best
  marketing tools feel invisible.

Content policy: zero specifics — no internal data, metrics, or campaign
names; tools by name with generic blurbs; the agent described conceptually.

## Tech

Vite + React 19 + TypeScript, @react-three/fiber, three.js,
@react-three/postprocessing, Tailwind. Meshopt-compressed GLBs, WebAudio
synthesized SFX, full keyboard/screen-reader paths, deep-linkable chapters.
Source: https://github.com/tarang-tj/Coke-Recap
